messages:
ada: Brainstorm: unify pagination resume across Py/TS/Go with a tiny ResumeSession primitive. Keep API minimal.

mike: Agree. Two quick modes: SERVER_CURSOR (opaque) and CLIENT_TOKEN (idempotency token).

toni: Ergonomics sketches?

ada: TS: for await (const page of client.listItems(q)) { if (page.resumeToken) save(page.resumeToken) }
Python: with client.list_items(q) as s: for p in s: ...; token = s.resume_token
Go: it := client.ListItems(ctx, p); page, token, err := it.Next(ctx)

mike: Important: distinguish last_acknowledged_token vs in_flight token if SDK prefetches. Expose on_token callback for apps.

toni: Retries: transport should only retry idempotent RPCs. For iterator failures surface ResumeableError with last_resume_token. Leave auto_resume opt-in.

mike: Also add ErrResumeExpired. For partial page delivery require server dedupe or monotonic offsets.

ci-bot: ada opened RFC draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/rfcs/pull/2400

ada: I'll author RFC with ResumePolicy enum, PersistResumeToken callback, and cross-lang error shapes. Owners: ada (RFC), mike (transport), toni (Go/TS). Target: EOW.
